decisions.reason: After two selling seasons this care line is embedded in the firm's core wood-floor aftercare offer, so management is likely to defend the earlier investment and explain any weak uptake as temporary.

This underlay foam remains more droppable than core flooring and care products, but after already pruning another underlay-related launch management is likely to keep this complementary system product on the market.
The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's core business and probably required substantial range, sales, and production commitment, which makes management especially reluctant to withdraw it.
